products.descriptionShort: Ram blowout preventers to API 16A, 6A and NACE MR0175: single or double ram, 7-1/16" to 30" bore, 5,000 to 20,000 psi, -59 °C to 177 °C, for drilling, workover and completion.
products.descriptionLong:
The core of the well-control stack. Hydraulic rams close on the pipe, on the open hole or shear through the string to shut the well in a kick. For deep wells, two ram preventers are usually combined with an annular preventer, and a rotating device where the well is drilled under pressure.

Pressure-control and well-service equipment is the hardware between the well and everything downstream: it holds and directs well pressure while drilling, testing, stimulating and producing. Each piece is built to API 6A, 16A or 16C for its working pressure, temperature class and material class, with sour-service materials to NACE MR0175 / ISO 15156 where the well needs them.

Construction

  • Single or double ram body; pipe, variable-bore, blind and blind-shear rams
  • Hydraulic bonnet cylinders with manual locking
  • Flanged or studded top and bottom, side outlets for choke and kill lines
  • Temperature ratings T-75/250 to T-0/350 (-59 °C to 177 °C)

Sizes and ratings

Published range: 7-1/16" to 30" nominal bore, 5,000 to 20,000 psi working pressure, in api 6a material classes dd, ee, ff, hh. End connections: API 6A flanged or studded. Operation: hydraulic, with manual locks.

Each unit is configured to the job; the general arrangement drawing and data book index come with the quotation.

Testing and documents

Hydrostatic tests to API 6A / 16A / 16C at the PSL ordered, with function tests of valves and controls, with the material certificates and the pressure-test record supplied with the equipment. Third-party inspection and extra tests are added when the order specifies them.

Supply

Ram blowout preventers are supplied from Dubai to projects, plants and maintenance teams across the GCC, the wider Middle East and Africa. Most are built to the order specification, so delivery depends on size, class, material and operator; standard carbon-steel sizes move fastest. We review the data sheet before quoting and flag anything that needs clarifying, such as a missing pipe schedule or an operator torque that has not been sized.
